== Dated PC image versions ==
The exact Holotable sources for this family date to 2018-07-08, 2022-12-23. These images retain the same game text while their published orientation, frame or artwork changes. Original bytes and documented unscaled crops accompany each article. Historical pages do not invent playable IDs. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== June 2017 source and chronology ==
The actual composed lower cutout from [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 7, prints <code>E</code>. The cover directs using it with the original physical card, so only uncovered original upper fields are inherited from [[:File:ANH-D-comewithme-hires.webp]]. The source cover gives text as of June 1, 2017; the precise first publication day is not established. Later full-face repository dates are first located records. The source order is 2017 partial, first located 2018 full face marked E, then later full face marked D-E1. Current <code>2_118</code> remains with the latest full face; no historical executable ID is invented. The final Decipher Glossary Supplement, page 2, retains the one-pilot capacity sentence while separately saying all permanent pilots are removed from a target with several. This cutout instead prints one replacement pilot per removed pilot. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
